cloud_init.heredoc_script:
#cloud-config
users:
  - default
  - name: github-runner
    groups: [wheel]
    shell: /bin/bash
runcmd:
  - dnf install -y curl git jq python3 python3.11 python3.11-pip unzip tar gzip
  - curl --fail --location --output /tmp/ripgrep.tar.gz https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/releases/download/15.2.0/ripgrep-15.2.0-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
  - echo 'a740b91c82eaf9914cfedd353572f2791cbe0162c84101ee0951058f4dcbc90d  /tmp/ripgrep.tar.gz' | sha256sum --check
  - tar xzf /tmp/ripgrep.tar.gz -C /tmp
  - install -o root -g root -m 0755 /tmp/ripgrep-15.2.0-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/rg /usr/local/bin/rg
  - rm -rf /tmp/ripgrep.tar.gz /tmp/ripgrep-15.2.0-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
  - mkdir -p /opt/actions-runner
  - curl --fail --location --output /tmp/actions-runner.tar.gz https://github.com/actions/runner/releases/download/v2.336.0/actions-runner-linux-arm64-2.336.0.tar.gz
  - echo '58b758e420b87093fbd4bfddd368074960053e2f1388f01848c82624b90f27d1  /tmp/actions-runner.tar.gz' | sha256sum --check
  - tar xzf /tmp/actions-runner.tar.gz -C /opt/actions-runner
  - chown -R github-runner:github-runner /opt/actions-runner
  - rm -f /tmp/actions-runner.tar.gz
